item.research_question: What are the preparation technologies and properties of refractory high entropy alloys (RHEAs)?
item.material_system: Refractory high entropy alloys (RHEAs) composed of elements such as Mo, Nb, Ta, V, W, Ti, Zr, Hf, Cr, and Re
item.processing_route: Arc melting, powder metallurgy, laser cladding, and magnetron sputtering
item.test_conditions: High temperature environments, corrosive solutions, and irradiation conditions
key_findings: RHEAs have excellent mechanical properties at high temperatures
RHEAs have good wear resistance and corrosion resistance
RHEAs have poor oxidation resistance, but it can be improved by adding protective elements
RHEAs have good radiation resistance and phase stability after ion irradiation
The addition of elements such as Al, Cr, and Ti can improve the oxidation resistance of RHEAs
item.mechanism: The high entropy effect, lattice distortion effect, sluggish diffusion effect, and 'cocktail' effect contribute to the excellent properties of RHEAs
item.limitations: The preparation technologies of RHEAs are limited due to the high melting points of constituent elements, and the chemical composition of RHEAs is complex
item.future_work: Further research is needed to improve the oxidation resistance and radiation resistance of RHEAs, and to develop new preparation technologies
quotes: The preparation technologies of RHEAs are limited compared with other HEAs
The chemical composition of RHEAs is complex, and it is easy to form complex oxides in the oxidation process

records.text: Paper card. Question: What are the preparation technologies and properties of refractory high entropy alloys (RHEAs)?. System: Refractory high entropy alloys (RHEAs) composed of elements such as Mo, Nb, Ta, V, W, Ti, Zr, Hf, Cr, and Re. Processing: Arc melting, powder metallurgy, laser cladding, and magnetron sputtering. Test conditions: High temperature environments, corrosive solutions, and irradiation conditions. Findings: RHEAs have excellent mechanical properties at high temperatures; RHEAs have good wear resistance and corrosion resistance; RHEAs have poor oxidation resistance, but it can be improved by adding protective elements; RHEAs have good radiation resistance and phase stability after ion irradiation; The addition of elements such as Al, Cr, and Ti can improve the oxidation resistance of RHEAs. Mechanism: The high entropy effect, lattice distortion effect, sluggish diffusion effect, and 'cocktail' effect contribute to the excellent properties of RHEAs. Limitations: The preparation technologies of RHEAs are limited due to the high melting points of constituent elements, and the chemical composition of RHEAs is complex. Future work: Further research is needed to improve the oxidation resistance and radiation resistance of RHEAs, and to develop new preparation technologies. Quote: "The preparation technologies of RHEAs are limited compared with other HEAs"
